content_sections.heading: ICAR CIRCOT Young Professional II at a Glance

rows.details: ICAR Central Institute for Research on Cotton Technology (ICAR CIRCOT)
Engineering Microbial Factories for Enhanced Xylitol Production from Cotton Lignocellulosic Biomass using CRISPR/Cas9 Technology
Till completion of the project (31 March 2027)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess the essential educational qualifications specified for the position. Desirable qualifications and specializations are also considered during evaluation. Essential Qualification: Master's Degree in Molecular biology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Microbiology, or a related discipline. Desirable Qualification: Specialization in genetic engineering, bioinformatics tools, or CRISPR/Cas9 technology. Age Limit: 21 to 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per Government of India rules.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected Young Professional II will receive a consolidated emolument of Rs. 42,000/- per month. The position is purely temporary, contractual, and co-terminus with the project up to 31 March 2027. There is no provision for absorption or re-employment in ICAR-CIRCOT or ICAR after the completion of the time-bound project.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICAR CIRCOT Young Professional II
content_sections.text: Download the application format provided in the official notification PDF. Fill out the application form with all required personal and academic details. Attach self-attested copies of certificates supporting age, qualifications, experience, and a No Objection Certificate (NOC) if currently employed. Send the completed application via email to [email protected] on or before 25 October 2026 (05:30 PM). Bring all original documents and certificates at the time of the walk-in interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates will attend a walk-in interview at ICAR-CIRCOT, Adenwala Road, Near Five Gardens, Matunga, Mumbai 400 019. Candidates currently employed elsewhere must submit a valid NOC from their current employer, without which they will not be considered for the interview. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Date of Interview: 28.10.2026 Reporting Time: 2:00 pm Interview Time: 2:30 pm onwards

faq.question: Q1. Is the Young Professional-II position permanent?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is purely temporary and contractual, co-terminus with the project up to 31 March 2027, with no provision for absorption or re-employment in ICAR.

faq.question: Q2. What is the age limit and relaxation applicable for the post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 45 years, with relaxations provided as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q3. What documents are required for currently employed candidates?
faq.answer: Candidates currently employed elsewhere must submit a valid No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their current employer via email and bring original documents to the interview.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection procedure and interview venue?
faq.answer: Selection involves a walk-in interview conducted at ICAR-CIRCOT, Adenwala Road, Near Five Gardens, Matunga, Mumbai 400 019 on 28 October 2026 starting at 2:30 pm.
